## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Evidence contract

State whether this affects the frozen frame, direct screening, classifier output, database, web application, or machine readable metadata.

## Checks run

List the exact commands and manual checks completed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Tests or contract checks cover changed behaviour.
- [ ] Documentation and machine readable metadata are current.
- [ ] Missing coverage remains unknown, not negative.
- [ ] No credential, private data, or restricted metadata is included.
